'''2004 Iowa State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship played on Saturday 31 July 2004 at Mayhem Comics & Games, 2532 Lincoln Way, Ames, Iowa, with [[Nick Kolnik]] as tournament director.<ref name="pcf-3644-49785">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=49785#49785 2004 Iowa SWCCG State Championship], Nick Kolnik, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (16 July 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040908230840/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=3644%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> Twenty-five players from five states (Iowa, North Dakota, Minnesota, Wisconsin and Missouri) took part. No player went undefeated, and eight players still had a realistic chance of reaching the final confrontation going into the sixth game. [[Jim Li]] won; [[Sam Tashima]] took second and waived his right to a final confrontation.<ref name="pcf-3644-51759">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=51759#51759 2004 Iowa SWCCG State Championship], Nick Kolnik, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (1 August 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040908230840/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=3644%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Mayhem Comics & Games, 2532 Lincoln Way, Ames, Iowa<ref name="pcf-3644-49785" />
* '''Dates:''' 31 July 2004, 11:00 a.m.<ref name="pcf-3644-49785" />
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Nick Kolnik]]<ref name="pcf-3644-49785" />
* '''Structure:''' six games and a final confrontation; decklists required<ref name="pcf-3644-49785" />
* '''Entry fee:''' $5.00<ref name="pcf-3644-49785" />
* '''Players:''' 25<ref name="pcf-3644-51759" />
* '''Winner:''' [[Jim Li]]<ref name="pcf-3644-51759" />

Trophies were to be awarded to the winner and the runner-up, and the winner received a bye into Day 2 of the [[2004 World Championship|World Championship at Gen Con]]. All participants were to receive prizes, including uncut sheets, tournament foils, oversized cards and booster packs.<ref name="pcf-3644-49785" /> Kolnik said that the tournament would start some time after 11:00.<ref name="pcf-3644-50169">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=50169#50169 2004 Iowa SWCCG State Championship], Nick Kolnik, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (18 July 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040908230840/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=3644%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>
